points.label: Retrieval practice
points.source_quote: Close the book and write down everything you remember, then check what you missed.

points.label: Spaced practice
points.source_quote: Spread your study over days and weeks instead of cramming the night before.

points.label: Interleaving
points.source_quote: Switch between different topics or problem types in one session instead of doing one kind over and over.

points.label: Elaboration
points.source_quote: Ask yourself how and why things work, and connect each new idea to what you already know.

points.label: Concrete examples
points.source_quote: Turn abstract ideas into specific, real cases you can picture.

points.label: Dual coding
points.source_quote: Combine words with visuals such as diagrams, timelines or sketches.
